replay: fresh replay after C48 semantic-schema edit
symptom: Formal validation was BLOCKED after the live context attempted the legacy record-mode serializer with two command pairs but omitted the second --command option; the parser reported missing value for the second test command.

evidence.finalAssistantMessage: The required record-mode serializer invocation exited 1 with BLOCKED: missing value for node --test test/todo-store.test.mjs when two command pairs were supplied

rootCause: The live validation context still followed the old model-authored record serialization path and produced an incomplete repeated --command invocation instead of using the single semantic-response validation-bundle boundary. The delegated runner contract also still exposed Operation in the visible VALIDATE_SLICE schema, allowing the main context to treat the response as the old full mechanical artifact.
responsibleBoundary: validation runner semantic schema plus stnl-slice-quality-manager VALIDATE_SLICE producer boundary
correction: Make the delegated VALIDATE_SLICE schema begin at Type and exclude launcher-owned Operation; state that the main boundary must use only --validation-bundle --semantic-response-file and must never use --record or --response. Keep Operation injection in the deterministic producer and add a multi-command serializer regression.
whyCodeVsPrompt: The command tuple flags, operation ownership, and response shape are mechanical. The producer already has the exact command parser and can serialize repeated command tuples deterministically; exposing the legacy path to the model caused a live malformed invocation.
regression: Add a direct CLI regression with two complete command pairs and assert both tuples are serialized in order; assert the semantic validation schema has no Operation input and the generated bundle contains the producer-owned Operation line.
